title: Major Glow Balm

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Lotions & Body Oils > Body Moisturizers > Bath & Body

descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Radiant Finish✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Without Parabens

What it is: An illuminating face and body balm that delivers a glass-like glow in two universally flattering shades for a luxe, glossy finish.


Skin type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily


Formulation: Balm


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Jojoba Seed Oil: Moisturizes, soothes, and protects the skin.

- Shea Butter Esters: Hydrate and visibly soften skin for a natural, radiant glow.

- Rice Bran Emollients: Create a rich, flexible film with a wet-looking finish.


How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

-For body, apply Glow Balm using the Patrick Ta Body Brush on legs, shoulders, and décolletage; reapply as desired.

-For face, apply to the high points of the cheek bones, lips, and eyes using a brush or finger.

-To minimize transferability, use a small amount and massage into clean, dry skin.

-Major Glow Balm should be stored in a cool, dry place. In warmer temperatures, refrigeration is suggested.

Ingredients+

-Jojoba Seed Oil: Moisturizes, soothes, and protects the skin.

-Shea Butter Esters: Hydrate and visibly soften skin for a natural, radiant glow.

-Rice Bran Emollients: Create a rich, flexible film with a wet-looking finish.


Capric/Caprylic Triglyceride, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Jojoba Esters, Diisostearyl Malate, Simmodsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Wax, Shea Butter Ethyl Esters, Hydrogenated Polybutene, Microcrystalline Wax, Fragrance. May Contain +/-: Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Titanium Dioxide, Mica, Tin Oxide, Synthetic Flurophlogopite, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate.
